verdict.rationale: Groq documents serving custom LoRA adapters on its own infrastructure, which covers the serving half of the story. Its docs describe these adapters as 'pre-made', so the fine-tuning step must happen off-platform, and only the upload-and-serve half is delivered. missing for 10: on-platform fine-tuning or training jobs on user data, a documented training-to-deployment workflow on the same platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration of LoRA serving.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune a supported base model on my own data and serve the result on the same platform
